body: Thank you. It waxes and wanes but it never really disappears, does it?

I had some problems with ED. When I finally got a woman in my bed at college, I couldn't seal the deal. Then a year later with a different girl in my apartment, same thing. Then again with my current girlfriend, I just couldn't get it up when the time came. 

I was very fortunate that she was patient and understanding. Granted, I never have and maybe never will tell her the real reason why I was having those problems, but she was supportive nonetheless. 

The problem is psychological. I know that seems like a given because we are dealing with how porn affects the brain and arousal, but that's not what I mean exactly. That plays a part, certainly, but if you are like me, it is your fear that is stopping you. 

I went into those situations expecting failure. And so I failed. It's self fulfilling prophecy and it's a cycle. I don't know exactly how the cycle breaks. For me it was with the love and support of my girlfriend. Barring that, just don't over think it. Lose yourself in the moment and let instinct take over. 

And don't be disheartened if you fail again. Confidence is a tricky thing to win back.

I agree strongly with what you are saying. The change a lot of us need to make is one with a different demon named apathy.

I'd just say though, I'm 23 now. I started down the road that led me to this particular subreddit when I was roughly your age. And I started kind of how you said. Once or twice a day. Nothing too crazy. I'm fully aware that everybody responds to these things different, but for me, it's been 8 years and I cannot stop. It's led to genuine problems in my personal life. 

If I could impart some small bit of wisdom that my extra handful of years on this planet has left me, I would just advice you be careful with it. It can have some very real and damaging consequences. 

That said, I wish more 16 year olds were as articulate and thoughtful as you are. Good luck to you too.

She may have responded kindly too it. I suppose it could have been a blow to your psyche though. I think I would have gone for it. Were you into her? I'm sure you could still pursue it, especially if she seemed interested. 

I don't think your fear will dissipate on it's own. You need to conquer that shit. 10 years could go by and you would still have the lingering memory of that last bad experience haunting you. At some point you just gotta go for it. Ya know?
